Vendored, unmodified copies of third-party libraries so the viewer works offline (no CDN needed at demo time).

- `three/` - three.js r169 (MIT, see `three/LICENSE`): `build/three.module.js` plus the addons the viewer imports.
- `rapier/` - @dimforge/rapier3d-compat 0.14.0 (Apache-2.0, see `rapier/LICENSE`), WASM embedded in `rapier.es.js`.
